type: post-hoc audit-only successor; not blind replication
hypothesis: The A02 delayed independent deadline sample may classify one effect persisted after nominal deadline as present; an audit-only event-time reconciliation should expose the discrepancy without modifying A02.

decision.exact_deadline_rule: No nonzero post-hoc sampling-lateness tolerance is introduced. Any actual snapshot_ns > nominal deadline_ns leaves exact-deadline oracle timing unresolved and yields HOLD_AUDIT_TIMING.
decision.descriptive_reconstruction: Expected payload with raw persisted_ns <= nominal deadline_ns is on-time; this reconstruction is descriptive and cannot override HOLD.
decision.errors: Malformed/missing/duplicate rows or custody mismatch yields STOP_REVIEW_ERRORS.
decision.h_classification: Always NOT_EVALUATED unless exact-deadline samples are shown; an audit-only review cannot produce H_PASS.
